Grandma's Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies recipe (handwritten card from 1987): Mix 1 cup softened butter, 3/4 cup packed dark brown sugar, and 1/2 cup granulated sugar until fluffy. Beat in 2 eggs and 2 teaspoons vanilla. In a separate bowl, combine 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon baking soda, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Gradually add dry ingredients to wet.
